message: 🚀 New Update on the Way! We are working hard on the next big update for Extreme AI Voice Typer. The upcoming update will bring amazing new features and significantly improve your typing experience! If you have any feature requests, run into any bugs, or just have feedback, please feel free to contact us. You can reach out directly through WhatsApp or by filling out the feedback form, both available in General Settings > Contact Us. We'd love to hear from you! Stay tuned, something big is coming very soon!
